name: uv_async_send

ownership.argument: Identified by its own structure and it cross-confirms the measured p67 loop layout: the pipe write descriptor really is at loop+364.

provenance.source: Sets the async's pending word at handle+108 with an LDREX/STREX pair, then takes the loop from handle+4 and writes one byte through nx_write 0xC1D2640 to fd *(loop+364), the loop's pipe write end on this build. 92 callers.

notes: Identified by its own structure and it cross-confirms the measured p67 loop layout: the pipe write descriptor really is at loop+364.
